methodologicalDecision.rationale: Approved for research use as a conservative point-in-time methodology. ALFRED realtime_start is accepted as date-level evidence of historical availability. Because exact intraday publication time is not established, AvailableAt is represented conservatively as 23:59:59.999 UTC on the realtime_start date, making the observation usable from the following UTC day. Long observed lags are retained without backward adjustment, and the identified negative-lag anomaly remains excluded. This methodological approval does not authorize historical admission.
